summary: sync-pricing skips Sonnet (id mismatch) + backfill misses on pricing-window edge
description:
Two related bugs surfaced when running 'npm run sync-pricing' + 'npm run backfill-cost' on prod after PR #33 merged.

1. sync-pricing skips anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5
   OpenRouter's /api/v1/models lists the canonical id as
   'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4.5' (dotted), but our internal id (in
   src/lib/model.ts MODELS.pro and persisted queries.model_used) is
   'anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5' (hyphenated).  Live completion calls
   work fine — OpenRouter accepts both forms — but the /models
   listing endpoint only uses the dotted form, so the allowlist
   match fails and Sonnet pricing never seeds.
   
   Fix: switch the allowlist from 'string[]' to a list of
   { srcId, openrouterId } pairs.  extractPricing looks up by
   openrouterId, stores under srcId so model_pricing.model_id
   matches what queries.model_used contains.

2. backfill misses on pricing-window edge
   computeCost looks up pricing where effective_from <= at AND
   (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > at).  Pricing rows have
   effective_from = now() (sync just ran).  Historical queries with
   created_at < now() fall outside the lookup window and throw.
   
   Fix: drop 'at: r.created_at' from backfill — use default (now).
   Backfilled cost reflects current pricing, which IS what the
   provider charged (DeepSeek and Sonnet pricing has been stable in
   the days these rows are dated).  Documented as the intentional
   approximation already noted in the script header.

Done when:
- sync-pricing seeds anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5 on next run
- backfill-cost updates all 8 historical rows with cost_usd
- Total ≈ $0.167 (matches OpenRouter dashboard)
- Tests updated for the new allowlist shape
